policy: Primary papers and official paper pages only; claims are bounded to method evidence.

sources.title: Permutation Testing for Dependence in Time Series
sources.supports: Ordinary permutation is exact under i.i.d./exchangeability, but can be invalid for dependent uncorrelated series without additional assumptions and studentization.

sources.title: Independence Testing for Temporal Data
sources.supports: Block permutation can be asymptotically valid and consistent under explicit stationarity, dependence-measure and block-parameter assumptions.

sources.title: Double Machine Learning for Time Series
sources.supports: Random cross-fitting designed for independent samples violates sequential structure; time-series adaptations require stronger structure such as stationarity/time reversibility.

sources.title: Reconstructing regime-dependent causal relationships from observational time series
sources.supports: Persistent latent regimes can change causal directions, lags, effects and autocorrelation; regime learning must be part of causal discovery.

sources.title: Estimating Transfer Entropy in Continuous Time Between Neural Spike Trains or Other Event-Based Data
sources.supports: Traditional source-time-shift nulls can fail; a local permutation scheme was introduced for the studied process.

sources.title: Nearest-Neighbours Estimators for Conditional Mutual Information
sources.supports: CMI and transfer entropy have high data requirements, dimensionality problems and estimator bias requiring calibration.

sources.title: Finding emergence in data by maximizing effective information
sources.supports: NIS+ learns macro dynamics by maximizing effective information, while the paper notes observational prediction is associative, input-distribution dependent and data hungry.

sources.title: Partial Effective Information Decomposition for Synergistic Causality
sources.supports: PEID defines unique and synergistic effective information under maximum-entropy interventions; its synergy depends on the declared source partition and intervention model.

sources.title: Multivariate Partial Information Decomposition
sources.supports: Higher-order lattice decompositions face counterexamples and impossibility results, blocking naive multi-source additive interpretations.

sources.title: The mathematical landscape of partial information decomposition
sources.supports: PID properties and redundancy axioms are partly incompatible and no single consensus measure satisfies every desideratum.

sources.title: Validating Causal Abstraction Metrics on Simulated Complex Systems
sources.supports: Even perfect output-only IIA can miss invalid intermediates; hidden confounders, excluded variables and XOR backup paths require stronger interventional faithfulness tests.

sources.title: Is Causal Abstraction Enough for Mechanistic Interpretability?
sources.supports: Unconstrained nonlinear alignment maps can yield near-perfect IIA even for random networks, so the alignment family must be constrained.

sources.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
sources.supports: J-space is tested with interventions and matched perturbation controls, but the work is about functional access and explicitly takes no position on phenomenal consciousness.

sources.title: The Ignition Index: Measuring Global Workspace Dynamics in Language Models
sources.supports: Ignition steepness is a structural/decodability diagnostic; the paper says depth is not temporal recurrence, probes are not causal use, and causal amnesic probing remains future work.
